description: The SDK pin was moved by hand to the commit of v0.1.0-pre.8, a pre-release (main really was there until 2026-10-05). ADR 0006 pins the SDK to a release tag, so the report says the pin is not on a release, names the tag it is on without calling it one, and puts it in the issue. The SDK axis independently proposes the SDK of the newest release.

expect.title_is: Compat sweep: the SDK pin is not on a release tag
issue_contains: - **SDK pin:** `v0.0.0-20260923091534-d3480d2a7efa` (at upstream `v0.1.0-pre.8`, which is not a release).
The SDK pin is not the commit of an upstream release tag.
